# Project Atlas — Steering Group, 17 March 2026

Present: Priya Raman, Marcus Webb, Aisha Okonkwo, VP of Platform.

## Decisions

The steering group confirmed that the tax engine migration stays deferred. It
will not be funded this year and remains on the existing platform.

The group released half of the contingency reserve to cover the staging replica
provisioning, leaving roughly six percent held back.

## Actions

Aisha Okonkwo to scope the historical invoice cleanup and return a staffing
estimate by 3 April.

Marcus Webb to start reconciliation testing against the staging replica rather
than waiting for production cutover.

## Noted

The group noted that no live fallback exists for the statement mailer and asked
for the vendor risk to be reviewed again at the June meeting.
